description: Output-replay scenario (work unit 4.393) for the EPLDatabaseRestartStatement execution of regression-lib/src/main/java/com/espertech/esper/regressionlib/suite/epl/database/EPLDatabaseJoin.java (ordinal 18; the earlier output-replay slices epl-database-join covered ordinals 1, 19, 15, 17 and 2, epl-database-join-2 covered ordinals 3, 20, 16, 8 and 4, and epl-database-timebatch covered ordinal 5). The Java oracle uses the established esper-mysql mysql:8.0 Docker fixture and the pinned MySQL SupportDatabaseService configuration, while the Go runner uses the identical canonical 10-row fixture through a function-fed HistoricalProvider. This scenario compares only observable listener output and the undeployed-send/redeploy delivery guards; it does not prove JDBC connection acquisition, release, transaction, or pool-exhaustion semantics, which remain open in the database capability. The byte-exact statement is @name('s0') select mychar from SupportBean_S0 as s0, sql:MyDBWithRetain ['select mychar from mytesttable where ${id} = mytesttable.mybigint'] as s1. The initial deployment is listener-less; each of 100 cycles undeploys, sends with no statement deployed, redeploys the same compiled statement with a fresh listener, and sends once for mychar Z. The trace contains one listener record per cycle at the fixed epoch, with no records for undeployed sends.
